fusions.name: Shallows Lunge
fusions.desc: Kicks off and lunges up to 6 tiles onto a target, clamping on for 15 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolled Under
fusions.desc: Launches up to 5 tiles onto a target at or below 25% health, seizes it by the leg and rolls, dealing 22 damage. It uses up every affliction on the target and adds 1.6 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Coiled Haunches
fusions.desc: Holds still for 1.5 seconds, then your damage rises by 30% for 10 seconds and your movement speed by 25% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Breath Held Long
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next ability deals 40% more damage. Once every 15 seconds.
